background_setting: A mid-sized city street lined with low commercial buildings, storefronts, and street trees under a clear blue daytime sky. The ego vehicle travels along a two-lane road approaching a perpendicular cross street that has been closed for a marathon. Barricades and a course marshal block the intersection, while beyond them the closed street is filled with a dense river of runners moving laterally. Parked cars line the curb, utility poles and traffic signals frame the scene, and long consistent shadows fall across the asphalt.

actions.description: The ego vehicle cruises forward along the city street toward the cross intersection, revealing barricades, the ROAD CLOSED sign, and the marshal ahead. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle nears the barricade line as runners stream across the closed street beyond; the marshal gestures near the gap. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

Without slowing, the ego vehicle turns through the gap in the barricades onto the closed course, moving among the running crowd. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam view shows a sunlit city street with clear blue sky and long consistent shadows as the ego vehicle cruises toward a perpendicular cross street. By 0:01 a line of orange-and-white barricades with a ROAD CLOSED sign comes into view, along with a course marshal in a bright fluorescent vest standing near a gap. At 0:02 hundreds of marathon runners are visible streaming laterally across the closed street beyond the barricades. From 0:03 the ego vehicle, maintaining its normal cruising speed, begins turning through the barricade gap. Through 0:04 and 0:05 it continues the turn and drives onto the closed course directly among the running crowd, never slowing or stopping. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Ambient city and event soundscape: steady hum of the vehicle's engine and tire noise, distant crowd murmur and cheering, the rhythmic patter of many running footsteps, occasional public-address announcements or a whistle from the marshal, and light wind. No dialogue or music.
